features.name: agent_log_tap_max
features.rationale: Compress the skewed maximum inter-tap interval while retaining the observed tail association.

features.name: agent_tap_tail_ratio
features.rationale: Separate occasional long intervals from a person's typical interval.

features.name: agent_tap_nonalt_interval
features.rationale: Interaction between slower intervals and nonalternating events; not a validated arrest measure.

features.name: agent_tap_asymmetry
features.rationale: Unsigned button imbalance, without interpreting it as clinical laterality.

features.name: agent_tap_relative_iqr
features.rationale: Scale interval dispersion by the median instead of overall mean.

features.name: agent_shimmer_scale_difference
features.rationale: Compare longer and shorter amplitude perturbation summaries measured in the same units.

features.name: agent_pitch_relative_sd
features.rationale: Dimensionless pitch dispersion, with no claim that it isolates PD.

features.name: agent_log_walk_speed
features.rationale: Simple nonlinear speed transform; weak discovery association warrants skepticism.

features.name: agent_log_walk_cadence
features.rationale: Simple nonlinear cadence transform as a low-complexity walking hypothesis.

features.name: agent_tap_voice_tail
features.rationale: Test whether timing-tail and acoustic perturbation signals interact.

features.name: agent_tap_walk_interaction
features.rationale: Cross-task product of interval and device-estimated step length; descriptive, not mechanistic.
